body:
On the podium, after the results.

Level 1: "Splendid! Here is your animal license, level 1. Wear it with pride!"
Level 2: "Marvellous! Your license is now level 2."
Level 3: "Bravo! Level 3! You may now care for any animal in Cozy Town."
Almost there (1 thing missing): "One more {win / healthy week} and your license grows!"
After: "Find your license in My pets." (once)

Rules used: license levels 1-3 (wins + healthy weeks), top 3 counts as a win, never taken away, card in My pets.
short: Sir Barkley hands the animal license on the podium
title: Sir Barkley: license lines
